meta.title: Open Source Everything | Free versions of paid apps
meta.description: We rebuild apps that charge a subscription as free, open source projects. Start with Speak Away, voice dictation for Mac that runs on your device.
hero.sub: We rebuild apps that charge a subscription as free, open source projects. One at a time.
hero.alt: Speak Away's home screen on a Mac with a six day streak, words dictated, time saved and an activity grid. The app's interface is in Spanish.
projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Each one replaces a paid app. Same job, no subscription, code you can read.
projects.next: More are coming. We take one subscription app at a time and rebuild it.

why.title: Software you can read, run and change.
why.free.text: No subscription for what runs on your device.
why.open.text: The code is on GitHub under the MIT license. Build it yourself or download it ready to use.
why.local.text: Your voice and your text stay on your device by default.
